architect.path: Accredited degree, ~3,700 documented experience hours (AXP), then the six-division ARE exam. Landscape architecture runs the parallel LARE route.
architect.time: 2–5 years after the degree, set by experience hours and exam pass rates, not by skill overlap.
architect.note: Only the title and the stamp are gated: unlicensed designers work in every firm, but cannot call themselves architect or sign drawings.
architect.label: State architecture license (RA/ARB) — registration required to practice/title
architect.title: Architect

ch.gate: Architekt/in — mostly NOT a protected practice
ch.path: In most cantons anyone may plan and sign buildings — unlike the US. A few cantons (Geneva, Ticino, Neuchâtel, Vaud) restrict practice to registered architects (REG A/B or equivalent).
ch.time: Where required, REG registration reviews your degree and practice record rather than setting an exam clock.

landscape-architect.path: Accredited degree, ~3,700 documented experience hours (AXP), then the six-division ARE exam. Landscape architecture runs the parallel LARE route.

landscape-architect.note: Only the title and the stamp are gated: unlicensed designers work in every firm, but cannot call themselves architect or sign drawings.
landscape-architect.label: State landscape-architecture license in most states
landscape-architect.title: Landscape Architect

structural-engineer.path: ABET-accredited engineering degree, FE exam, ~4 years under a licensed engineer, then the PE exam in your discipline.
structural-engineer.time: Typically 4–6 years from graduation; the experience clock, not the exams, sets the floor.
structural-engineer.note: Gates responsible charge — signing and sealing — not employment. Product and coordination seats hire unlicensed engineers every day; that distinction is what makes several of our routes honest.
structural-engineer.label: PE license required to sign/seal structural work
structural-engineer.title: Structural Engineer

mechanical-engineer.note: Gates responsible charge — signing and sealing — not employment. Product and coordination seats hire unlicensed engineers every day; that distinction is what makes several of our routes honest.
mechanical-engineer.label: PE required for sign-off roles; not for most product/manufacturing roles

accountant.path: 150 semester hours of education, the four-part Uniform CPA Exam, plus 1–2 years of supervised experience depending on state.
accountant.time: 1–3 years alongside work for most candidates.
accountant.note: Required for public accounting and external audit sign-off; most corporate accounting and FP&A roles do not require it.
accountant.label: CPA license required for public accounting/attest work
accountant.title: Accountant

ch.path: Statutory audits require RAB-licensed auditors (expert-revisor credential via the eidg. diploma routes). General accounting is ungated; the Treuhänder/expert suisse diplomas are market expectations rather than law.
ch.time: The federal diploma routes run years part-time, employer-sponsored as in the US CPA pattern.

auditor.path: 150 semester hours of education, the four-part Uniform CPA Exam, plus 1–2 years of supervised experience depending on state.
auditor.time: 1–3 years alongside work for most candidates.
auditor.note: Required for public accounting and external audit sign-off; most corporate accounting and FP&A roles do not require it.
auditor.label: CPA typically required for external audit
auditor.title: Auditor

ch.path: Statutory audits require RAB-licensed auditors (expert-revisor credential via the eidg. diploma routes). General accounting is ungated; the Treuhänder/expert suisse diplomas are market expectations rather than law.
ch.time: The federal diploma routes run years part-time, employer-sponsored as in the US CPA pattern.

financial-analyst.path: Sponsorship by a member firm, the SIE, then the role-specific Series exam (7, 63, 65/66...).
financial-analyst.time: Weeks to months — the fastest gate on this page, because a firm sponsors you after hiring.
financial-analyst.note: Only securities-touching roles need them; the licenses ride on employment rather than preceding it.
financial-analyst.label: FINRA licenses required for securities roles; CFA common
financial-analyst.title: Financial Analyst

compliance-officer.path: Sponsorship by a member firm, the SIE, then the role-specific Series exam (7, 63, 65/66...).
compliance-officer.time: Weeks to months — the fastest gate on this page, because a firm sponsors you after hiring.
compliance-officer.note: Only securities-touching roles need them; the licenses ride on employment rather than preceding it.
compliance-officer.label: Licenses/certifications by sector (FINRA, AML)
compliance-officer.title: Compliance Officer

underwriter.time: Weeks to months — the fastest gate on this page, because a firm sponsors you after hiring.
underwriter.note: Only securities-touching roles need them; the licenses ride on employment rather than preceding it.
underwriter.label: State insurance licenses for some lines
underwriter.title: Underwriter

actuary.path: A sequence of 7–10 professional exams taken while working; employers fund and schedule study time.
actuary.time: ASA/ACAS in ~4–7 years, fellowship beyond. The exams effectively ARE the career ladder.
actuary.note: No state license — but the exam sequence gates advancement as hard as any statute.

body.name: Society of Actuaries / Casualty Actuarial Society

actuary.label: Credentialing exams (SOA/CAS) effectively required
actuary.title: Actuary

lawyer.path: JD from an accredited school (3 years), the bar exam in each state of practice, character and fitness review.
lawyer.time: 3–4 years including the degree; there is no experience-based shortcut in most states.
lawyer.note: Paralegal and compliance routes exist without it — several of our legal-adjacent routes point exactly there.
lawyer.label: Bar admission required — jurisdiction-specific
lawyer.title: Lawyer

ch.path: Swiss law degree, then a cantonal legal traineeship (usually 1–2 years) and the cantonal bar exam; the patent registers you canton by canton.

registered-nurse.path: Accredited nursing degree (ADN 2 years / BSN 4 years), then the NCLEX-RN. Nurse practitioners add a graduate degree (MSN/DNP) and national certification on top.
registered-nurse.time: 2–4 years to RN; +2–4 for NP. The Nurse Licensure Compact lets one license work across ~40 states.
registered-nurse.note: The hardest-gated destination we track with the highest demand behind it — Swiss and US boards alike are fed by nursing shortage.
registered-nurse.label: State RN license (NCLEX) required
registered-nurse.title: Registered Nurse

ch.path: Swiss route: HF diploma or FH bachelor in nursing. Foreign diplomas need SRK recognition before practice; the NAREG register records health professionals.
ch.time: The Swiss degrees run 3 years; SRK recognition of a foreign diploma is a months-scale procedure, sometimes with compensation measures.

nurse-practitioner.path: Accredited nursing degree (ADN 2 years / BSN 4 years), then the NCLEX-RN. Nurse practitioners add a graduate degree (MSN/DNP) and national certification on top.
nurse-practitioner.time: 2–4 years to RN; +2–4 for NP. The Nurse Licensure Compact lets one license work across ~40 states.
nurse-practitioner.note: The hardest-gated destination we track with the highest demand behind it — Swiss and US boards alike are fed by nursing shortage.
nurse-practitioner.label: State APRN license + national certification required
nurse-practitioner.title: Nurse Practitioner

ch.path: Swiss route: HF diploma or FH bachelor in nursing. Foreign diplomas need SRK recognition before practice; the NAREG register records health professionals.
ch.time: The Swiss degrees run 3 years; SRK recognition of a foreign diploma is a months-scale procedure, sometimes with compensation measures.

physician.path: Medical school (4 years), USMLE/COMLEX steps, residency (3–7 years), state licensure.
physician.time: 7–11 years post-baccalaureate. No adjacent-skill route shortens it.
physician.note: The clearest case of the honesty rule: 60% skill overlap means nothing against this gate.
physician.label: MD/DO, residency, and state medical license (7+ yrs of training)
physician.title: Physician

ch.path: Federal diploma or MEBEKO recognition (EU/EFTA diplomas recognize most smoothly), then cantonal practice permission.
ch.time: Like the US: the medical degree and specialty training set the clock, in years.

physical-therapist.path: Doctor of Physical Therapy (3 years post-bachelor), then the NPTE and state licensure.
physical-therapist.time: ~3 years for the DPT if prerequisites are done.
physical-therapist.label: DPT degree + state PT license (NPTE) required
physical-therapist.title: Physical Therapist

ch.path: FH bachelor in the profession (physiotherapy, nutrition and dietetics...); foreign diplomas via SRK/GesBG recognition. Medical practice assistants (MPA) run the EFZ apprenticeship route.
ch.time: 3-year degrees; recognition procedures for foreign credentials in months.

pharmacist.path: PharmD (4 years), NAPLEX plus state law exam.
pharmacist.time: 4+ years; internship hours accrue during the degree.
pharmacist.label: PharmD + state pharmacist license (NAPLEX) required
pharmacist.title: Pharmacist

therapist.path: Master's or doctorate in the discipline, 2,000–4,000 supervised clinical hours, then the state exam. Genetic counselors run the ABGC board route.
therapist.time: 2–4 years post-degree for the supervised hours alone.
therapist.note: Non-clinical roles (research, program, care coordination) hire without the license — that is where the adjacent routes point.

body.name: State behavioral-health boards (interstate: PSYPACT for psychologists)

therapist.label: State clinical license (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) required
therapist.title: Therapist / Counselor

ch.path: Master's in psychology for the protected title; psychotherapy adds a federally accredited postgraduate training.
ch.time: The psychotherapy training runs ~4–6 years post-master, part-time.

psychologist.path: Master's or doctorate in the discipline, 2,000–4,000 supervised clinical hours, then the state exam. Genetic counselors run the ABGC board route.
psychologist.time: 2–4 years post-degree for the supervised hours alone.
psychologist.note: Non-clinical roles (research, program, care coordination) hire without the license — that is where the adjacent routes point.

psychologist.label: State psychologist license required
psychologist.title: Psychologist

social-worker.label: State license required for clinical roles (LCSW)

genetic-counselor.note: Non-clinical roles (research, program, care coordination) hire without the license — that is where the adjacent routes point.

body.name: State behavioral-health boards (interstate: PSYPACT for psychologists)

genetic-counselor.label: Master's in genetic counseling + ABGC board certification; state licensure in most states
genetic-counselor.title: Genetic Counselor

dietitian.path: Accredited graduate degree, supervised practice (DI), the CDR exam; state licensure in most states.
dietitian.note: 'Nutritionist' is unregulated in many states; 'dietitian' is the protected title.
dietitian.label: RD/RDN credential + state licensure in most states
dietitian.title: Dietitian

ch.path: FH bachelor in the profession (physiotherapy, nutrition and dietetics...); foreign diplomas via SRK/GesBG recognition. Medical practice assistants (MPA) run the EFZ apprenticeship route.
ch.time: 3-year degrees; recognition procedures for foreign credentials in months.

teacher.path: Bachelor's + approved preparation program + exams (Praxis in many states). Nearly every state also runs an alternative-certification route for career changers that puts you in the classroom while you certify.
teacher.time: Alternative routes: often one summer to provisional, 1–2 years to full. Administrators add a graduate credential.
teacher.note: The alternative-certification route is the single most career-changer-friendly gate in this list.
teacher.label: State teaching certification required for public schools
teacher.title: Teacher

ch.path: PH (university of teacher education) diploma, recognized across cantons via EDK. Career changers ('Quereinsteigende') have dedicated PH admission routes in most cantons amid the teacher shortage.
ch.time: Quereinstieg programs typically run 2–3 years, often part-time alongside classroom work.

school-administrator.path: Bachelor's + approved preparation program + exams (Praxis in many states). Nearly every state also runs an alternative-certification route for career changers that puts you in the classroom while you certify.
school-administrator.time: Alternative routes: often one summer to provisional, 1–2 years to full. Administrators add a graduate credential.
school-administrator.note: The alternative-certification route is the single most career-changer-friendly gate in this list.
school-administrator.label: State administrator certification typically required
school-administrator.title: School Administrator

ch.path: PH (university of teacher education) diploma, recognized across cantons via EDK. Career changers ('Quereinsteigende') have dedicated PH admission routes in most cantons amid the teacher shortage.
ch.time: Quereinstieg programs typically run 2–3 years, often part-time alongside classroom work.

teaching-assistant.time: Alternative routes: often one summer to provisional, 1–2 years to full. Administrators add a graduate credential.
teaching-assistant.note: The alternative-certification route is the single most career-changer-friendly gate in this list.
teaching-assistant.label: Paraprofessional requirements vary by state
teaching-assistant.title: Teaching Assistant

electrician.path: Registered apprenticeship (4–5 years, PAID from day one), then the journeyman exam. HVAC adds EPA 608. Welding runs on AWS code certifications per process.
electrician.time: 4–5 years to journeyman — but earning throughout, which no degree-gated route offers.
electrician.note: The apprenticeship model means the gate and the paycheck run concurrently. Solar installation is largely ungated (NABCEP is voluntary) — one reason it appears as a fast route.

body.name: State licensing boards; EPA for refrigerant handling

electrician.label: State/journeyman electrician license required
electrician.title: Electrician

ch.path: EFZ apprenticeship (4 years), and independent installation work requires an ESTI permit under the NIV ordinance, which in turn requires the higher federal diploma (eidg. Diplom) or equivalent recognition.
ch.time: 4 years to EFZ; several more to the diploma behind a full installation permit.

pilot.path: Commercial/ATP certificates with mandated flight hours (ATP: 1,500) for pilots; carrier-run FAA certification for flight attendants; Part 107 written exam for drone pilots.
pilot.time: Pilots: years and real money. Flight attendants: weeks, via the airline. Drones: a written exam.
pilot.note: Three gates under one regulator, from the heaviest on this page to one of the lightest.
pilot.label: FAA commercial/ATP certificate required
pilot.title: Pilot

flight-attendant.path: Commercial/ATP certificates with mandated flight hours (ATP: 1,500) for pilots; carrier-run FAA certification for flight attendants; Part 107 written exam for drone pilots.
flight-attendant.time: Pilots: years and real money. Flight attendants: weeks, via the airline. Drones: a written exam.
flight-attendant.note: Three gates under one regulator, from the heaviest on this page to one of the lightest.
flight-attendant.label: FAA certification via the airline required
flight-attendant.title: Flight Attendant

drone-pilot.path: Commercial/ATP certificates with mandated flight hours (ATP: 1,500) for pilots; carrier-run FAA certification for flight attendants; Part 107 written exam for drone pilots.
drone-pilot.time: Pilots: years and real money. Flight attendants: weeks, via the airline. Drones: a written exam.
drone-pilot.note: Three gates under one regulator, from the heaviest on this page to one of the lightest.

real-estate-agent.path: Pre-licensing coursework (60–180 hours), state exam, brokerage sponsorship.
real-estate-agent.time: Weeks to a few months — a light gate with a commission-only income model behind it.
real-estate-agent.note: Development itself is ungated; the licenses attach to brokerage and contracting activities within it.
real-estate-agent.label: State real-estate license required
real-estate-agent.title: Real Estate Agent

real-estate-developer.path: Pre-licensing coursework (60–180 hours), state exam, brokerage sponsorship.
real-estate-developer.time: Weeks to a few months — a light gate with a commission-only income model behind it.
real-estate-developer.note: Development itself is ungated; the licenses attach to brokerage and contracting activities within it.
real-estate-developer.label: Brokerage/contractor licenses depending on activity
real-estate-developer.title: Real Estate Developer

police-officer.path: Academy (typically 4–8 months) plus field training; hiring precedes the academy.
police-officer.label: Police academy + state certification (POST) required
police-officer.title: Police Officer

paramedic.path: EMT certification first, then a 1–2 year paramedic program and the NREMT exams.
paramedic.label: State paramedic license (NREMT); 1–2 yr accredited program
paramedic.title: Paramedic

dental-hygienist.path: Accredited dental-hygiene associate degree (its own clinical program — NOT credited by dental-assistant experience), national board + clinical exam.
dental-hygienist.note: The occupation that taught this site its honesty rule: assistants do not become hygienists by adjacency, only through the degree.

body.name: State dental boards / ADA CODA programs

dental-hygienist.label: State RDH license; accredited dental-hygiene associate degree (~3 yrs)
dental-hygienist.title: Dental Hygienist

medical-assistant.time: 3-year degrees; recognition procedures for foreign credentials in months.
